description: Issue 24 pilot: Raelen's A Bundle of Trouble (Classic 5545, 8 bundles; owner-approved adaptation 4) restored after the final quest filter and played on the map: a few bundle markers near Eastvale, ~2 s gather bar on the chosen marker (tap again to cancel), one bundle into the real bag per success, attack roll once per attempt (attackChance 0.05 is the proposal from the issue, not yet approved) that interrupts the attempt and opens the existing ambush fight; the pending attack is saved so reload cannot skip or reroll it; hand-in at 4/4 takes exactly 4 bundles once. No XP/money/loot for gathering itself. Tilde-r sorts this after the Eagan dialogue and quest-item patches.
